posts.text: HULTEN delte dette tidligere, tenker det trenger litt Topp plassering nå etter noen folk er ferdig på jobb! LinkedIn kopi  Benjamin McLeod ( . Følger Founder @ Convey Bio | Co-Host of The Biotech Voyager  This is one of the hottest early-stage companies so far this year. The company is Circio Holding ASA They've built a gene expression system that uses circular RNA biogenesis It's seriously impressive: - RNA that last 75x longer than normal - significant reduction in immune response over standard gene delivery highly potent, to the extent that an eye delivery resulted in a 10x response with ONE-TENTH OF THE DOSE Seriously impressive run this year Many thanks to Victor Levitsky for a short overview We barely scratched the surface on all the cool data they've generated Anything else you'd add? Drop it in the comments. https://www.linkedin.com/posts/benjamin-mcleod_this-is-one-of-the-hottest-early-stage-companies-ugcPost-7513474825743437824-HyJM/?highlightedUpdateUrn=urn%3Ali%3Aactivity%3A7513557495605374976&highlightedUpdateType=SOCIAL_SHARE&origin=SOCIAL_SHARE&utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_android&rcm=ACoAAGGSC24B2EXoI8xUZIcaQ9SFwUPmSQJHIyU

posts.author: Hulten
posts.text: Skreiv dette til han Nice one Benjamin Circio has actually put together a pretty solid data package this year - expression advantage now shown in heart, eye and CNS, first therapeutic gene data, and long durability on the non-viral CAR-T side. Worth a closer look if you haven't dug into the full 2026 progress yet. Fikk svar Definitely need to read deeper  Då får vi se om han kommer me noe senere
